variants.name: multi_value_probe_return
variants.note: bend5k_o2 ALREADY inlines $direct.probe into $direct.look (and $direct.ins into $direct.fill, $direct.bmix into $direct.sweep) and eliminates per-step Pair heap alloc/free. $direct.probe is dead code; $direct.look allocates only 1 Pair at loop exit (2048 total across 7.5s = <0.01%).

variants.name: bonus_borrowed_array_get_and_has_in_look
variants.note: Real bottleneck in hashmap is Array.get(Chain) hitting p113_rt_array_pair (val>>57 != 0 for boxed CCons) + $direct.has hitting p111_rt_take on shared CCons nodes. Borrowing in $direct.look alone buys 1.30x (+23.0%); applying to fill+sweep too projects ~1.6-1.8x.

probes.verdict: KILL (multi-value return for hashmap) / GO-ALT (borrowed read-only Array.get + chain walk)
probes.estimated_loc: N/A for probe (0% gain); ~250 LOC for borrowed read-only walk

variants.name: stack_512x8_rep_stosq
variants.note: Beats gcc-10 -O2 (17.0ms)! Eliminates heap alloc, freelist, p111_rt_sink, and array tag/mask decoding in collect+sorted_fold.

probes.estimated_loc: ~180-250 LOC (escape check + stack alloca + direct rsp-indexed array ops)

probes.idea: Loop-Versioned Array Hoisting (eliminate in-loop test dp, dp; jz slow)
probes.reason: 100%-predicted macro-fused test+jz off the critical path costs only 1.0-1.2% even with 24 checks per iteration in terrain. Nowhere near justifying loop versioning complexity (~300+ LOC).

probes.idea: General Multi-Op cmov + Board-Bit Reg Caching (gameoflife)

variants.name: run_calls_orig_inlined_step
variants.note: CRITICAL FINDING: bend5k_o2 inlines $direct.step into $direct.run ONE level, leaving 16 calls to $direct.step_cell per gen! Simply calling the already-inlined $direct.step (or multi-level inlining step_cell into run) gives 3.13x and ALREADY beats gcc-10 -O2 by 1.80x!

variants.name: run_cmov_only
variants.note: Pure multi-op cmov is -2.0% SLOWER than branched origstep because settled 4x4 soups have predictable branches and cmov adds extra cmp+sete+or+cmov uops.

variants.name: run_cmov_plus_board_bit_cse
variants.note: CSE/caching the 16 extracted board bits (16 extractions instead of 144) adds another 1.57x on top of inlining -> 0.35x C (2.83x faster than gcc-10 -O2)!

probes.verdict: KILL (multi-op cmov alone: -2.0%) / STRONG GO (fix inliner depth so run doesn't lose step_cell inlining: 3.13x; + local CSE of pure shift/and ops: +1.57x)
probes.estimated_loc: ~30 LOC for inliner fix (3.13x!); ~150 LOC for local CSE (+1.57x)

probes.idea: Jump-Table match Dispatch vs Mode Unboxing (lexer $direct.lex)

variants.name: jumptable_only
variants.note: Replaces 12-way linear cmp chain (up to 24 branches/char) with 12-entry jump table, keeping heap InId/InNm alloc/free identical.

variants.name: jumptable_plus_unboxed_mode
variants.note: Unboxing Mode into (tag, val) registers adds only +2.7% over jump table because gen() String construction dominates the remaining ~900ms.

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (jump-table match: 1.50x end-to-end on lexer)

probes.idea: True Perceus In-Place IReuse (overwrite unique node fields without freelist push/pop)

variants.name: clean_freelist_no_spurious_keep
variants.note: CRITICAL FINDING: In $direct.bst.up, nested multi-arm match (BF{v,other,True{}} <> rest vs False{}) causes bend5k_o2 to emit spurious p111_rt_keep on path and BF before testing left, wrapping unique nodes in shared 0x82 boxes! Fixing that alone buys 4.98x (+79.9%)!

variants.name: true_inplace_IReuse
variants.note: Pure Perceus in-place IReuse (overwriting BNode <-> BF in place without freelist push/pop/program/cid_hot checks) buys 1.170x (+14.5%) on top of clean_freelist, and 5.83x combined vs baseline!

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (nested-match spurious-keep fix: 4.98x!) + GO (true in-place IReuse: +14.5% pure / 5.83x combined)
probes.estimated_loc: ~80 LOC for nested-match decision tree without spurious keep (4.98x); ~150 LOC for in-place IReuse (+14.5%)
